metadata.description: Claude Code mods kept in dotfiles.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Turns checkable rules from agent-rules into tool.call denies: popup hygiene, agent spawns, worktrees, a few Bash traps.

plugins.name: pr-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt with the current branch's PR checks and merge state; toast and sound when the checks finish.

plugins.name: popup-ping
plugins.description: Re-notifies with a sound every 5 min while an AskUserQuestion popup waits unanswered.

plugins.name: nudge-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt with clickable standup and retro reminders instead of SessionStart text.

plugins.name: auto-recall
plugins.description: On prompts like 'wróćmy do' or 'kontynuuj', attaches a capped Hindsight recall as context.

plugins.name: agent-board
plugins.description: Pane listing the session's subagents with status, model and age, and a button to view each.

plugins.name: shot-pick
plugins.description: /shot: pick screenshots in a tuios popup with an image preview and put their paths in the prompt.

plugins.name: remember
plugins.description: /zapamietaj saves the given text or the mouse selection to Hindsight.

plugins.name: sprawy
plugins.description: Band above the prompt with the session's separate requests, queued in order, each following its agent until done.

plugins.name: pulpit
plugins.description: One summary line above the prompt (items, PR, standup, retro); a press opens one pane with every mod's details and actions.

plugins.name: shot-shrink
plugins.description: Halves browser screenshots (browsentic, vimma) before the model reads them: about a quarter of the image tokens.

plugins.name: mcp-digest
plugins.description: Big results from read-only connectors go through Haiku first; the model gets notes plus the full result's path. /mcp-digest off|on.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: At 250k context tokens a toast suggests /handoff, which compacts the chat into a detailed hand-over.
